flowContents.name: ABC Hub ETL Pipeline
flowContents.comments: Z2D DWDF Mini Project 01 - ABC Hub. Operational PostgreSQL -> bronze/silver/gold analytical PostgreSQL. See README.md for how to run.

processGroups.name: 01 Extract - Operational DB (incremental)
processGroups.comments: QueryDatabaseTableRecord per source table; state = max(updated_at) per table (watermark).

processors.name: Tag review batch
processors.comments: Attaches the table's schemas and cleansing SQL (generated from nifi/flow_config.py) so the shared validate/cleanse/load stages stay generic.

properties.cleanse.sql: SELECT "review_id" AS "review_id", "customer_id" AS "customer_id", "content_id" AS "content_id", CASE WHEN rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN rating ELSE CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) END AS "rating", NULLIF(TRIM(review_text), '') AS "review_text", "review_date" AS "review_date", "created_at" AS "created_at", "updated_at" AS "updated_at", NULLIF(TRIM(TRAILING ',' FROM CASE WHEN rating IS NULL OR rating NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN CAST('RATING_INVALID,' AS VARCHAR(500)) ELSE CAST('' AS VARCHAR(500)) END), '') AS "dq_flags", '$${batch.id}' AS "_batch_id" FROM FLOWFILE

properties.duplicates.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(TRIM(email)) ORDER BY customer_id) AS dedupe_rank FROM FLOWFILE f) numbered WHERE dedupe_rank > 1
properties.cleanse.sql: SELECT "customer_id" AS "customer_id", "customer_no" AS "customer_no", TRIM(first_name) AS "first_name", TRIM(last_name) AS "last_name", LOWER(TRIM(email)) AS "email", NULLIF(TRIM(phone), '') AS "phone", "date_of_birth" AS "date_of_birth", CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(gender), ''), 'Unknown') AS VARCHAR(500)) AS "gender", "registration_date" AS "registration_date", INITCAP(TRIM(status)) AS "status", "created_at" AS "created_at", "updated_at" AS "updated_at", NULLIF(TRIM(TRAILING ',' FROM CASE WHEN email <> LOWER(TRIM(email)) THEN CAST('EMAIL_NORMALISED,' AS VARCHAR(500)) ELSE CAST('' AS VARCHAR(500)) END || CASE WHEN status <> INITCAP(TRIM(status)) THEN CAST('STATUS_STANDARDISED,' AS VARCHAR(500)) ELSE CAST('' AS VARCHAR(500)) END || CASE WHEN gender IS NULL OR TRIM(gender) = '' THEN CAST('GENDER_DEFAULTED,' AS VARCHAR(500)) ELSE CAST('' AS VARCHAR(500)) END), '') AS "dq_flags", '$${batch.id}' AS "_batch_id" FROM (SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(TRIM(email)) ORDER BY customer_id) AS dedupe_rank FROM FLOWFILE f) numbered WHERE dedupe_rank = 1

properties.cleanse.sql: SELECT "payment_id" AS "payment_id", "customer_id" AS "customer_id", "rental_id" AS "rental_id", "subscription_id" AS "subscription_id", "payment_method_id" AS "payment_method_id", ABS(amount) AS "amount", "payment_date" AS "payment_date", INITCAP(TRIM(payment_type)) AS "payment_type", INITCAP(TRIM(status)) AS "status", "created_at" AS "created_at", "updated_at" AS "updated_at", NULLIF(TRIM(TRAILING ',' FROM CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN CAST('AMOUNT_SIGN_FIXED,' AS VARCHAR(500)) ELSE CAST('' AS VARCHAR(500)) END), '') AS "dq_flags", '$${batch.id}' AS "_batch_id" FROM (SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, payment_type, amount, payment_date, rental_id, subscription_id ORDER BY payment_id) AS dedupe_rank FROM FLOWFILE f) numbered WHERE dedupe_rank = 1

properties.cleanse.sql: SELECT "stream_id" AS "stream_id", "customer_id" AS "customer_id", "content_id" AS "content_id", "device_id" AS "device_id", "start_time" AS "start_time", "end_time" AS "end_time", COALESCE(watch_duration, CAST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, start_time, end_time) AS INTEGER)) AS "watch_duration", CASE WHEN completion_percentage > 100 THEN 100.0 WHEN completion_percentage < 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE completion_percentage END AS "completion_percentage", "created_at" AS "created_at", "updated_at" AS "updated_at", NULLIF(TRIM(TRAILING ',' FROM CASE WHEN watch_duration IS NULL THEN CAST('WATCH_DURATION_DERIVED,' AS VARCHAR(500)) ELSE CAST('' AS VARCHAR(500)) END || CASE WHEN completion_percentage > 100 THEN CAST('COMPLETION_CAPPED,' AS VARCHAR(500)) ELSE CAST('' AS VARCHAR(500)) END || CASE WHEN completion_percentage < 0 THEN CAST('COMPLETION_FLOORED,' AS VARCHAR(500)) ELSE CAST('' AS VARCHAR(500)) END), '') AS "dq_flags", '$${batch.id}' AS "_batch_id" FROM (SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, content_id, device_id, start_time ORDER BY stream_id) AS dedupe_rank FROM FLOWFILE f) numbered WHERE dedupe_rank = 1

properties.cleanse.sql: SELECT "rental_id" AS "rental_id", "customer_id" AS "customer_id", "inventory_id" AS "inventory_id", "rental_date" AS "rental_date", "due_date" AS "due_date", "return_date" AS "return_date", "rental_fee" AS "rental_fee", CASE WHEN late_fee < 0 THEN CASE WHEN return_date IS NULL OR return_date > due_date THEN ABS(late_fee) ELSE 0.0 END ELSE late_fee END AS "late_fee", INITCAP(TRIM(status)) AS "status", "created_at" AS "created_at", "updated_at" AS "updated_at", NULLIF(TRIM(TRAILING ',' FROM CASE WHEN status <> INITCAP(TRIM(status)) THEN CAST('STATUS_STANDARDISED,' AS VARCHAR(500)) ELSE CAST('' AS VARCHAR(500)) END || CASE WHEN late_fee < 0 AND (return_date IS NULL OR return_date > due_date) THEN CAST('LATE_FEE_SIGN_FIXED,' AS VARCHAR(500)) ELSE CAST('' AS VARCHAR(500)) END || CASE WHEN late_fee < 0 AND return_date <= due_date THEN CAST('LATE_FEE_ZEROED,' AS VARCHAR(500)) ELSE CAST('' AS VARCHAR(500)) END), '') AS "dq_flags", '$${batch.id}' AS "_batch_id" FROM FLOWFILE

labels.label:
Scheduled by 'Trigger Gold Build' (cron '0 30 * * * ?'). Each step is one PostgreSQL function = one transaction.
Dimensions are loaded before facts (left column down, right column up); any failure marks the run FAILED in etl.pipeline_run and stops the chain.

ABC Hub ETL Parameters.name: ABC Hub ETL Parameters

parameters.name: log.directory
parameters.description: Folder for rejected-record and failed-FlowFile files (relative paths resolve against NIFI_HOME)

parameters.name: source.jdbc.url
parameters.description: JDBC URL of the operational (source) PostgreSQL database

parameters.name: db.password
parameters.description: Database password. Leave empty to let the PostgreSQL JDBC driver read the pgpass file (%APPDATA%\postgresql\pgpass.conf on Windows, ~/.pgpass on Linux/macOS)

parameters.name: db.user
parameters.description: Database user for both pools (use a least-privilege ETL role in production)

parameters.name: jdbc.driver.path
parameters.description: Absolute path to the PostgreSQL JDBC driver jar

parameters.name: gold.full.refresh
parameters.description: true = rebuild every gold fact from silver; false = incremental (only changed keys)

parameters.name: target.jdbc.url
parameters.description: JDBC URL of the analytical PostgreSQL database
